signs.Aries: A sense of light relief and much laughter will wash over your current relationship today. If you have both been burdened by troubles connected with other issues in your lives, then take time to reconnect, and to bond with each other more deeply. Watch a funny movie and just have fun. You both deserve it!
signs.Taurus: Good humor and a need to see the funny side of your relationship characterize your love life today. You'll both feel the need to take a more liberal view of each other. Allow each other the space to be totally yourselves and open up to the genuine warmth you both share, especially if things aren't going as well as they could.
signs.Gemini: You and a loved one are becoming closer together in a warm and particularly caring way. Perhaps you have both been overworked lately and have not had an opportunity to relax and allow a sense of calm cheerfulness to humor you. Adopting a positive perspective that allows for a sense of humor will work wonders. Be kind to each other today!
signs.Cancer: You can have a ball today. Doing something fun together with your sweetheart will do you both a great deal of good. You need to find a way to talk to new and different people, so try communicating with some new social circles and broadening your outlook and horizon. Take a risk and move into the unknown. Pretty soon you will have some great new friends.
signs.Leo: Spend time with your love interest. If your latest liaison is not only a secret, but also a dangerous enterprise, then you may feel even more moved to take a gamble. Maybe you would like to take them out and show them off. Life and love are a continuing succession of changes and risks - perhaps yours will pay off today!
signs.Virgo: Today provides a good opportunity for you and a loved one to expand your circle of friends. Your social life is likely to liven up. Perhaps you both feel that your present social group has been limiting you of late. Be bold and do something new, as it may well lead to some fabulous new connections that will stand you in good stead.
signs.Libra: It is time to take a break from your usual punishing schedule, and to then decide on what you would like to do for an evening of fun and entertainment. Break all of your usual rules and move beyond the boundaries that keep you tied to a limited social circle. There is a whole exciting world out there to explore.
signs.Scorpio: A few interesting doors will open up for you today, especially in terms of love and romance - IF you can make the decision to do something different and possibly educational. Search online for places you can learn something new and fascinating, as there you may interact with a person who appeals to you on many varied and interesting levels. Don't be shy - go for it.
signs.Sagittarius: For once in your life you can drop that profound and enigmatic wall of silence that usually surrounds you when you interact with new people. Relax, and don't view every person that tries to talk to you as a potential enemy. You really can talk more openly and freely without having to play those power games at which you usually excel. You will enjoy becoming involved.
signs.Capricorn: Today you may meet that special person while at your local gym, if possible, or playing an individual sport like golf or tennis. Whatever you do, don't stay inside watching television. Use the energy of the day as an ideal opportunity to show off, to break through a few barriers, and to impress someone with your skill, openness, and great sense of humor.
signs.Aquarius: You and a loved one will sample a much-needed dose of humor. If a sense of warmth and shared laughter has been missing from your relationship for some time, then take this wonderful opportunity to go for a walk, meet up with friends if possible, or just do anything that’s fun - but do laugh! It will improve all aspects of your relationship no end.
signs.Pisces: This is a wonderful day for arranging a small get-together with close friends, if possible, and also for daring to invite someone special whom you have been quietly flirting with for some time. Openness, warmth, and heart-to-heart sharing are all in store. Tell this person how you feel about them and watch as the barriers between you come tumbling down, and love takes their place.
